title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1973-12-02
lineage: DAT (Tascam DA-40) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Transcendent soundboard capture of a standout 1973 second set with crystal‑clear instrument separation; pair with the first‑set matrix for the full show.
ai_review.review: The Miller soundboard upgrade delivers transcendent audio – superb instrument separation and subtle pitch correction that make the music feel larger than life. Reviewers describe the performance as a different, high‑energy vibe and one of ’73’s standout shows, though only the second set is present, so it’s best enjoyed alongside the first‑set matrix recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review praises both the musical performance and the exceptional soundboard quality; limited data (only one review) lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Transcendent clarity, beautiful instrument separation, pitch‑corrected mastering; only a portion of the show is present.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set only with a distinct vibe; reviewers suggest pairing it with the first‑set Dusborne matrix for complete flow.
